consentRequired.title: Tags wait for the visitor's consent
consentRequired.description: On: each tag loads only once the visitor consents to its category (analytics or marketing). Off: tags load at once, with Google Consent Mode granted, until the visitor makes a choice; a choice the visitor makes is still followed. Laws in many places (for example the EU's GDPR and ePrivacy rules and the UK's PECR) require consent before tracking; if you turn this off, you are responsible for following the law where you operate.
